categories.description: 流动性的终点，也是反馈的起点 · 观察波动率、交易承载能力与仓位杠杆。

indicators.name: SOFR与EFFR利差
indicators.explanation: 相同观察日的SOFR减EFFR。先规范化输入单位；输出为百分点（沿用%标签），4.10减4.00为0.10；缺少任一输入时为空，不跨日填充。

indicators.name: 美联储总资产
indicators.explanation: 美联储合并资产负债表总资产（扣除合并抵销），每周三时点值；原始百万美元除以1000后展示为十亿美元，非周平均。

notices.text: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.4.1, Assets: Total Assets: Total Assets (Less Eliminations from Consolidation): Wednesday Level (WALCL); distributed by FRED. 百万美元除以1000为十亿美元。
FRED citation: WALCL; retrieved 2026-11-17 (UTC).

indicators.name: 银行准备金
indicators.explanation: H.4.1存款机构在联储的准备金余额，未季调、周三时点值；百万美元除以1000为十亿美元。

notices.text: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.4.1, Reserve Balances with Federal Reserve Banks: Wednesday Level (WRBWFRBL); distributed by FRED.
FRED citation: WRBWFRBL; retrieved 2026-11-17 (UTC).

indicators.name: 准备金/商业银行资产（跨口径比值）
indicators.explanation: 同日H.4.1未季调准备金（先由百万转十亿美元）除以H.8季调商业银行总资产，再乘100。两者覆盖范围与季调口径不同，仅为跨口径研究比值，不是同一银行总体的资产占比；缺值或分母为零时为空，不填充。

source.name: 项目计算 · FRED · 100 * reserve-balances / bank-total-assets

notices.text: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.4.1, Reserve Balances with Federal Reserve Banks: Wednesday Level (WRBWFRBL); distributed by FRED.
Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.8, Total Assets, All Commercial Banks; seasonally adjusted (TLAACBW027SBOG); distributed by FRED.
Project calculation by Junyan Liu: 100 × normalized WRBWFRBL / TLAACBW027SBOG. 覆盖范围和季调口径不同，非同一银行总体的资产占比。

FRED citation: WRBWFRBL; retrieved 2026-11-17 (UTC).

indicators.name: TGA余额
indicators.explanation: H.4.1美国财政部一般账户余额，未季调、周三时点值；百万美元除以1000为十亿美元，非每日余额。

notices.text: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.4.1, U.S. Treasury, General Account: Wednesday Level (WDTGAL); distributed by FRED.
FRED citation: WDTGAL; retrieved 2026-11-17 (UTC).

indicators.name: ON RRP余额
indicators.explanation: 纽约联储临时公开市场操作中的美国国债抵押隔夜逆回购每日交易总额；原始单位为十亿美元，保持来源日期及零值，缺失不视为零；不含其他抵押品或期限。

notices.text: © 2026 Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Source: Overnight Reverse Repurchase Agreements: Treasury Securities Sold by the Federal Reserve in the Temporary Open Market Operations (RRPONTSYD); distributed by FRED. 十亿美元原值。
New York Fed content is subject to its Terms of Use.
FRED citation: RRPONTSYD; retrieved 2026-11-17 (UTC).

indicators.name: 贴现窗口用量
indicators.explanation: H.4.1一级信贷余额，未季调、周三时点值、百万美元；不包含二级或季节性信贷，不能解释为贴现窗口全部工具用量。

notices.text: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.4.1, Loans: Primary Credit: Wednesday Level (WLCFLPCL); distributed by FRED.
FRED citation: WLCFLPCL; retrieved 2026-11-17 (UTC).

indicators.name: 美联储隔夜正回购总量
indicators.explanation: FRED发布的隔夜正回购每日总量，来源为纽约联储临时公开市场操作；覆盖美国国债、联邦机构债及机构MBS。原始单位已为十亿美元，保持原值及来源日期；为每日交易量而非未偿余额；缺失值不视为零。

notices.text: © 2026 Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Content from the New York Fed subject to the Terms of Use at newyorkfed.org.

Source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Overnight Repurchase Agreements: Total Securities Purchased by the Federal Reserve in the Temporary Open Market Operations (RPONTTLD); distributed by FRED. 十亿美元原值。
FRED citation: RPONTTLD; retrieved 2026-11-17 (UTC).

indicators.name: 央行美元流动性互换工具用量（Swap Line）
indicators.explanation: H.4.1央行流动性互换未偿余额，未季调、周三时点值、百万美元；不是当周新增交易额。

notices.text: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.4.1, Central Bank Liquidity Swaps: Wednesday Level (SWPT); distributed by FRED.

indicators.name: FIMA Repo
indicators.explanation: H.4.1外国官方回购协议余额，未季调、周三时点值、百万美元；使用来源周三日期，不是周平均或交易流量。

notices.text: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.4.1, Repurchase Agreements - Foreign Official: Wednesday Level (H41RESPPALGTRFNWW); distributed by FRED.
FRED citation: H41RESPPALGTRFNWW; retrieved 2026-11-17 (UTC).

indicators.name: 信用利差-投资级
indicators.explanation: ICE BofA美国公司债券指数期权调整利差（OAS），日度收盘、未季调，百分比原值。FRED仅提供滚动三年历史（当前起于2023-11-20），月末观察值即使落在周末也保留来源日期。

notices.text: Source: ICE Data Indices, LLC, ICE BofA US Corporate Index Option-Adjusted Spread (BAMLC0A0CM); distributed by FRED. Maintainer confirmed ICE BofA index redistribution permission on 2026-11-18. FRED supplies a rolling three-year history for this series.
FRED citation: BAMLC0A0CM; retrieved 2026-11-18 (UTC).

indicators.name: 信用利差-高收益
indicators.explanation: ICE BofA美国高收益债券指数期权调整利差（OAS），日度收盘、未季调，百分比原值。FRED仅提供滚动三年历史（当前起于2023-11-20），月末观察值即使落在周末也保留来源日期。

notices.text: Source: ICE Data Indices, LLC, ICE BofA US High Yield Index Option-Adjusted Spread (BAMLH0A0HYM2); distributed by FRED. Maintainer confirmed ICE BofA index redistribution permission on 2026-11-18. FRED supplies a rolling three-year history for this series.
FRED citation: BAMLH0A0HYM2; retrieved 2026-11-18 (UTC).

indicators.name: 债券发行量
indicators.explanation: SIFMA经Wind EDB G1132499提供的总债券月度发行额，十亿美元原值。维护者确认口径为全期限、总发行额（非净额、非年初累计）；月末为观察期标签。国债与公司债已包含在总量中，三项不可相加。保存工作簿与CSV同步更新；缺失保留为空。
sources: data/sources/wind/bond-issuance.xlsx; sheet bond-issuance; column bond-issuance; Wind EDB G1132499; SIFMA US Fixed Income Securities Statistics

indicators.name: 银行贷款标准
indicators.explanation: SLOOS美国国内银行对大中型企业工商贷款收紧标准的净百分比；正值为净收紧，负值为净放松，未季调。来源以季度首日标记调查期，不代表该日已发布；按季度及上年同季比较。

notices.text: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), SLOOS, Net Percentage of Domestic Banks Tightening Standards for Commercial and Industrial Loans to Large and Middle-Market Firms (DRTSCILM); distributed by FRED.

indicators.name: 银行贷款
indicators.explanation: H.8美国商业银行信贷中的贷款和租赁总额，季调、截至周三的周度数据，十亿美元；不是仅商业及工业贷款。

notices.text: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.8, Loans and Leases in Bank Credit, All Commercial Banks; seasonally adjusted (TOTLL); distributed by FRED.
FRED citation: TOTLL; retrieved 2026-11-17 (UTC).

indicators.name: VIX指数
indicators.explanation: 芝加哥期权交易所波动率指数（VIX），日度收盘、未季调，指数点位原值。反映标普500指数期权隐含的近月波动率预期，不是已实现波动率；来源缺失值保留为空，不视为零，也不跨日填充。
